high_level_description: The image depicts a single jellyfish against a dark background. The jellyfish is translucent with a pale, almost white coloration, allowing its internal structures to be faintly visible. Its bell-shaped body is slightly elongated, and it has numerous long, thin tentacles extending from the underside of the bell. The tentacles appear delicate and wispy, with fine, thread-like strands that trail off into the darkness. There are no people or other objects present in the image. The setting is minimalistic, focusing entirely on the jellyfish, which is the central subject.
